geometry_floatScreen.door1499373: Host 1499339, normal (-0.848, 0.530). Corridor-side portal door:694:1499373:1 lies INSIDE the door footprint, +0.20 ft along the normal (corridor face +0.279 ft); the 10-2006 outline follows the office-side footprint face at -0.279 ft, so the portal is 0.479 ft from the destination outline.
geometry_floatScreen.why: Every approach walk leaves the portal at about 53 degrees to the door normal (first leg (160.237,844.586)->(160.223,844.739)); a 1 ft half-width strip at that angle reaches about 0.8 ft back along the normal and crosses the office outline. A straight departure would need to be within about 28.6 degrees of the normal to stay clear.
